decisions.reason: A core piqué upholstery fabric close to the established offer with its own page is likely to remain in the collection for several more seasons.
The semi-transparent bouclé-effect decorative fabric still fits current trends, but it is only mentioned on the website and a similar bouclé item was already dropped, so the risk is somewhat higher.
Flame-retardant jacquard curtains serve steady contract and hospitality demand and are a functional strength of the firm.
The double-face wool-blend fabric is still fairly recent, but blends conflict with the push to reduce hard-to-recycle materials, so the risk is moderate.
The braided-structure fabric was launched in 2024 and has its own page, so it is very likely to stay during its first seasons.
